OpcodeScan.doc: Index-driven scan opcodes. The non-index scan (Rewind/Next on a table cursor) lives in opcodes-rows; this family owns index-cursor open, seek, next, and rowid read.

OpenIdxRead.doc: Open a read-only cursor on the named index via storage.open_index_cursor; install at cursor slot (replace silently). TableNotFound -> Halt(Error).

SeekGE.doc: Position the index cursor at the smallest key >= regs[key_reg]. Jump(jump_if_miss) if no such entry; else Continue. Storage error other than miss collapses to Halt(IoError).

SeekGT.doc: Same as SeekGE with strict > comparator.

SeekLE.doc: Position at largest key <= regs[key_reg]. Jump(jump_if_miss) if no such entry; else Continue.

SeekLT.doc: Same as SeekLE with strict < comparator.

IdxNext.doc: Advance index cursor one entry. If another entry exists: Jump(jump_if_more) (loop-body convention — jump taken on HAS-NEXT, so loop body lives at jump_if_more). Else: Continue.

IdxRowid.doc: Read the rowid the index cursor currently points at into regs[dest_reg] as Value::Integer. Err(CursorClosed) -> Halt(Error) when the cursor is at EOF/BOF or closed.

execute.doc: Execute one scan opcode against state. Per-opcode semantics in master.md. Outer loop interprets the returned outcome (Continue | Jump(PC) | Halt(status)).
